patina_grazer.description: Green-crusted and unhurried, it combs copper dust from the rubble with its filter-plates spread wide, laying the metal it strains down over its own shell until the plating weathers to verdigris. The crust is not for fighting — it is simply what happens when a creature filters copper out of the rock for long enough. Where a belt's copper runs thin the herd drifts on, and a worked-out field loses its grazers for good.
